description: This file contains shell script tests for git hook behavior, specifically testing 'proc-receive' options and push scenarios with various options and expected outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Runs a test command/tool with specified arguments.
